What is read, where it is kept and how to remove it
NightBaseline reads sleep sessions and the measurements taken during them from Health Connect, only from the source you chose, once a day after you wake up.
Nightly values, your usual ranges and your settings are stored only in the app\'s private storage on this phone.
Nothing. NightBaseline has no internet access, no account, no analytics and no ads. It never writes, changes or deletes data in Health Connect.
You can turn off access in Health Connect at any time. Clearing the app\'s storage or uninstalling it deletes everything NightBaseline stored.
